_doc: The model TIER of each workflow stage (backlog P10, spec S2-3). Every stage ships at top: a stage moves to mid or cheap ONLY with `proof`, the repo path of the JSON a PLANT RUN wrote, COMMITTED in this repo: at least 3 planted defects of 3 different kinds whose input files exist and hash to the recorded sha256, each caught by a finding that quotes its input, one clean control (another file) with zero findings, the run's id and an existing transcript, for that stage, tier, template version AND template text (template_sha256, MODEL line aside; see tools/workflows/README.md for the shape); lint_templates.py checks it and render.py refuses to render without it. `verify` is pinned to top in lint_templates.PINNED_TOP, so no edit here can move it. render.py --format json maps a tier to the workflow agent() model option via `agent_model`: top MUST be null (no option: the coordinator's model), mid and cheap name a model.
